contract.description: The contract version this source was written against. A hub implementing contract 4 also reads sources written for 1, 2 and 3, whose shapes are subsets.

name.description: Unique among sources; used in URLs.

refresh_seconds.description: How often the hub fetches each widget again.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard limit on each fetch and show. detect has its own fixed limit.

network.description: Whether run makes network calls. Required, so that every source says, and shown to the user.

example_query.description: For a search widget: a query hub check-source runs it with.

ranges.description: Contract 3. For a timeseries widget: the time ranges the hub offers as buttons, such as 6h or 7d, first one shown first. The hub filters the points it was given; fetch returns the longest range.

shows.description: Entity types this source can show a section for. Each must be defined in entities.json.

page.description: The source's own view: an HTML file inside page/, relative to the source folder. The hub serves page/ and shows the page as the source's tab while it is working; see docs/contract.md, Views.
